fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: You can visit São Tomé and Príncipe for tourism for up to 15 days without a visa.
entry.es: Se puede visitar Santo Tomé y Príncipe por turismo hasta 15 días sin visado.
entry.quote: You can visit São Tomé and Príncipe for tourism for a period of up to 15 days without a visa.

entry.en: A 20-euro entry fee is payable on arrival, and US dollars or local currency can also be used.
entry.es: Hay que pagar una tasa de entrada de 20 euros a la llegada, y también se puede pagar en dólares estadounidenses o moneda local.
entry.quote: You must pay a 20-euro entry fee when you arrive in the country. You can also pay in US dollars or local currency.

entry.en: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe ser válido durante toda tu estancia.
entry.quote: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: Anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty must be declared at customs.
entry.es: Hay que declarar en la aduana todo lo que pueda estar prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

safety.en: The crime rate is generally low, but burglaries and armed robberies can happen.
safety.es: La tasa de delincuencia es generalmente baja, pero pueden producirse robos con allanamiento y atracos a mano armada.
safety.quote: The crime rate in São Tomé and Príncipe is generally low, but burglaries and armed robberies can happen.

safety.en: Many roads are in poor condition and unlit, and animals often walk on roads at night.
safety.es: Muchas carreteras están en mal estado y sin iluminación, y a menudo hay animales en ellas de noche.
safety.quote: Many roads are in poor condition and unlit, particularly outside the capital. Animals often walk on roads at night.

safety.en: Taxis and motorbike taxis are the only public transport and are often unsafe and in poor condition.
safety.es: Los taxis y mototaxis son el único transporte público y a menudo son inseguros y están en mal estado.
safety.quote: Taxis and motorbike taxis (‘motoqueiros’) are the only forms of public transport. They are often unsafe and in poor condition.

safety.en: Economic difficulties and political rows can occasionally lead to civil unrest.
safety.es: Las dificultades económicas y las disputas políticas pueden provocar disturbios civiles en ocasiones.
safety.quote: Economic difficulties and political rows over the handling of investments in São Tomé and Príncipe’s development can occasionally lead to civil unrest.

safety.en: Wikivoyage says road blocks near Santana and scams targeting tourists in the main city have been reported.
safety.es: Wikivoyage indica que se han notificado controles de carretera cerca de Santana y estafas dirigidas a turistas en la ciudad principal.
safety.quote: Road blocks near Santana have been reported, as well as scams targeting tourists in the main city.

safety.en: Wikivoyage says the black cobra is the only dangerous animal on the islands and anti-venom is available at local hospitals.
safety.es: Wikivoyage dice que la cobra negra es el único animal peligroso de las islas y que hay antiveneno en los hospitales locales.
safety.quote: The only dangerous animal in the islands is the black cobra

health.en: Medical facilities are limited, and many health conditions need evacuation to Europe, South Africa, Ghana or Gabon.
health.es: Los centros médicos son limitados y muchas dolencias requieren evacuación a Europa, Sudáfrica, Ghana o Gabón.
health.quote: Medical facilities on São Tomé and Príncipe are limited and many health conditions need evacuation to Europe, South Africa, Ghana or Gabon for treatment.

health.en: Wikivoyage says tap water is not fit for drinking, so boil it or stick to bottled water.
health.es: Wikivoyage dice que el agua del grifo no es potable, así que hay que hervirla o beber agua embotellada.
health.quote: Tap Water is not fit for drinking. Boil it or stick to bottled.

health.en: Wikivoyage says visitors should still take precautions against mosquito bites, such as repellent and bed netting.
health.es: Wikivoyage dice que los visitantes deben seguir tomando precauciones contra las picaduras de mosquito, como repelente y mosquiteros.
health.quote: visitors should still continue taking precautions against mosquito bites

health.en: You should have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover medical treatment abroad and repatriation.
health.es: Conviene tener un seguro médico de viaje adecuado y fondos accesibles para cubrir el tratamiento médico en el extranjero y la repatriación.
health.quote: Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment abroad and repatriation.

help.es: Para llamar a una ambulancia, marca el 222 22 22.
help.quote: Call 222 22 22 and ask for an ambulance.

help.en: Fire is 112, and police are 113 or 222 22 22.
help.es: Bomberos es el 112 y policía el 113 o el 222 22 22.

getting_in.en: Wikivoyage says the only way to enter is by plane, via São Tomé International Airport (TMS).
getting_in.es: Wikivoyage dice que la única forma de entrar es por avión, a través del aeropuerto internacional de Santo Tomé (TMS).
getting_in.quote: The only way to enter is by plane.

getting_in.en: Príncipe Airport (PCP) only receives domestic flights from São Tomé International Airport.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Príncipe (PCP) solo recibe vuelos nacionales desde el aeropuerto internacional de Santo Tomé.
getting_in.quote: This airport only receives domestic flights from São Tomé International Airport

getting_around.en: On São Tomé Island there are many taxis, including shared ones that depart when enough people are there.
getting_around.es: En la isla de Santo Tomé hay muchos taxis, incluidos compartidos que salen cuando hay suficiente gente.
getting_around.quote: there are many taxis, including shared ones that depart to other cities when enough people are there.

getting_around.en: Renting a car or scooter is common for tourists, though roads are often not in good condition.
getting_around.es: Es habitual que los turistas alquilen un coche o una scooter, aunque las carreteras suelen estar en mal estado.
getting_around.quote: It is common for tourists to rent a car or scooter to better explore all that the island has to offer. Beware that although roads are paved, they are often not in good condition.

getting_around.en: Commercial flights with small 19-seat Dornier 228 planes connect São Tomé to Príncipe.
getting_around.es: Vuelos comerciales con pequeños Dornier 228 de 19 plazas conectan Santo Tomé con Príncipe.
getting_around.quote: The aircraft used on this route are small 19 seat Dornier 228 propeller planes.

getting_around.en: The cargo boat to Príncipe takes 10 hours overnight and is not considered particularly safe, while faster charter boats take 3.5 hours.
getting_around.es: El barco de carga a Príncipe tarda 10 horas de noche y no se considera especialmente seguro, mientras que los barcos fletados tardan 3,5 horas.
getting_around.quote: Locals instead typically hop on a cargo boat, but the 10 hour overnight journey is not considered particularly safe. There are faster charter boats that can do the trip in 3.5h.

money.en: The currency is the new dobra (STN), and the import and export of local currency is prohibited.
money.es: La moneda es la nueva dobra (STN), y la importación y exportación de moneda local está prohibida.
money.quote: It is a restricted currency: the import and export of local currency is prohibited.

money.en: There are no ATMs that take overseas cards, so you must bring enough cash in euros or US dollars.
money.es: No hay cajeros que acepten tarjetas extranjeras, así que hay que llevar suficiente efectivo en euros o dólares estadounidenses.
money.quote: There are no ATMs that take overseas cards. You must bring sufficient cash in euros or US dollars.

money.en: Credit cards are not widely accepted, and there are only a small number of ATMs.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito no se aceptan ampliamente y solo hay unos pocos cajeros automáticos.
money.quote: Credit cards are not widely accepted in São Tomé and Príncipe.

money.en: Euros, and sometimes US dollars, are commonly accepted at larger restaurants and shops.
money.es: Los euros, y a veces los dólares estadounidenses, se aceptan habitualmente en restaurantes y tiendas más grandes.
money.quote: Euros, and sometimes US dollars, are commonly accepted at larger restaurants and shops.

money.en: Travelers' checks are no longer accepted.
money.es: Ya no se aceptan cheques de viaje.
money.quote: Travelers' checks are no longer accepted.
